Layer 09 applies uncertainty penalties.

It does not boost scores.
It does not override prior layers.
It does not promote records at runtime.
It does not accept manual overrides.
It does not modify Black Dragon.

Penalty sources:
- weak or insufficient authority
- ambiguous or rejected geography
- stale or invalid timestamps
- weak or single-source corroboration

Penalty classes:
- no_material_penalty
- minor_uncertainty_penalty
- moderate_uncertainty_penalty
- major_uncertainty_penalty
- rejected_runtime_or_synthetic_adjustment
